correctness.rationale: For squarefree binary F4, the order-4 projective automorphism (iX,iY,Z,W) has exactly four fixed points on each coordinate line. Local action on the two transverse coordinates is scalar ±i, giving eight 1/4(1,1) quotient points resolved by (-4)-curves. The invariant rational function field is C(X/Y,Z/W), and after these resolutions the rational pair-ratio map contracts the sixteen invariant lines joining fixed endpoint points over 4x4 grid U×V; away from those points its fibers are finite. Standard birational surface contraction identifies R as blow-up of P1xP1 in sixteen grid points. Independently reconstructed the intersection lattice: eight row/column strict transforms have square -4; sixteen exceptional curves square -1; D=4A+4B−2ΣE=−2K; K²=−8, rho 18, Euler 20. No bidegree-(2,2) curve passes through all sixteen grid points, so |-K| empty.
